# Ventustium

> Ventustium is the online alias of Kevin Luis Linuhung, a system infrastructure and DevOps enthusiast. ventustium.com is his personal site.

- Name: Kevin Luis Linuhung (also "Kevin Linuhung", alias "ventustium")
- Location: Indonesia (UTC+7)
- Focus: system infrastructure, DevOps, self-hosting, networking
- Stack: Linux, Docker, Kubernetes, MikroTik, Ruijie, Cloudflare, PHP, PostgreSQL, MySQL
- Hobbies: osu!, PC games on Steam, translating Japanese web novels
- Contact: kevin@ventustium.com
